T120.manual_summary: The left drive unit temperature has reached the first overheating threshold. Operation is still possible but thermal stress is detected.
actions_summary: Check cooling airflow and fan operation

T121.manual_summary: The right drive unit temperature has reached the first overheating threshold. This indicates elevated thermal load.
actions_summary: Inspect cooling and ventilation on the right drive unit

T122.manual_summary: The left drive unit temperature has exceeded the second overheating threshold. Protective power limitation may occur.
actions_summary: Stop operation and allow unit to cool

T123.manual_summary: The right drive unit temperature has exceeded the second overheating threshold. Continued operation may be restricted.
actions_summary: Allow the unit to cool down

T130.manual_summary: A drive command is detected while the seat switch is not active. Traction is blocked to ensure operator presence.

T132.manual_summary: The rear cover is open while a drive command is present. Vehicle movement is prevented for safety reasons.
actions_summary: Close and secure the rear cover

T135.manual_summary: The detected drive direction signals are not permitted for single-pedal operation. Input plausibility has failed.

T150.manual_summary: The indicated remaining battery capacity has fallen to a low threshold level. Performance may be reduced.

T151.manual_summary: The indicated remaining battery capacity has reached a critical level. Vehicle functions may be limited.

T190.manual_summary: The service cover of the hydraulic tank is detected as open. Safety interlock prevents normal operation.

T200.manual_summary: The control unit did not successfully complete or has not undergone the factory test procedure.

T201.manual_summary: An internal fault has been detected within the control unit software or processing logic.

T210.manual_summary: The supply voltage for traction-related sensors is above the allowable range. Sensor signals may be unreliable.

T211.manual_summary: The supply voltage for traction-related sensors is below the allowable range. Signal validity cannot be ensured.

T212.manual_summary: The traction sensor supply voltage is outside valid limits. Sensor data is considered invalid.

T231.manual_summary: The accelerator guidance signal is detected outside the permissible operating range.

T232.manual_summary: The accelerator reference signal is outside the valid range. Input plausibility is compromised.

T233.manual_summary: The accelerator guidance and reference signals do not correlate correctly. Dual-channel monitoring has failed.

T241.manual_summary: The signal from channel 1 of the steering angle sensor is outside the permitted range.

T242.manual_summary: The signal from channel 2 of the steering angle sensor is outside the permitted range.

T243.manual_summary: The signals from both steering angle sensor channels are not consistent with each other.

T351.manual_summary: The detected drive axle temperature is outside the valid operating range.

T353.manual_summary: The left drive unit temperature has exceeded the allowable limit, indicating overheating.

T355.manual_summary: The right drive unit temperature has exceeded the allowable limit. Protective measures may be active.

T391.manual_summary: The hydraulic oil temperature signal is implausible or faulty. Temperature monitoring cannot be relied upon.
actions_summary: Compare sensor reading with actual temperature

T443.manual_summary: Traction is not fully disabled despite the seat switch being inactive. A safety-related inconsistency is detected.

T491.manual_summary: The safety verification of the power electronics has failed. A safety-related fault is present.
actions_summary: Reset system and re-evaluate safety status

T750.manual_summary: The traction function has been disabled by the safety processor due to detected unsafe conditions.
